visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A pair of hands in transparent plastic gloves holds a red and white squeeze bottle of Lee Kum Kee oyster sauce against a white background. Large yellow text overlays the center. (2) The scene shifts to a kitchen studio where a male chef in a white uniform stands behind a wooden counter. He holds the sauce bottle and gestures enthusiastically towards the camera. (3) A close-up shows the chef opening the flip-top lid of the bottle and squeezing the thick, dark sauce into a clear glass bowl, demonstrating no residue on the nozzle. (4) The video cuts between the chef speaking and shots of the sauce being used on various dishes, including a plate of cooked greens and meat. (5) A split-screen comparison shows the traditional glass bottle next to the new squeeze bottle. (6) The final phase features the chef giving a thumbs up and smiling, followed by a product shot of both bottle types together with brand text.

(7) [Subtitle]: 最近有推出新包裝. (8) [Subtitle]: 擠壓瓶相當的方便. (9) [Subtitle]: 適用於醃味、芡汁、蘸食. (10) [Subtitle]: 煮炒多款菜式. (11) [Subtitle]: 化繁為簡 一匙提鮮. (12) [Subtitle]: 都會出好菜.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young Asian male chef with short dark hair, wearing a professional white chef's coat with logo embroidery on the chest.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A bright, clean kitchen studio with a light grey brick wall and a light wooden countertop. Kitchen utensils and bowls are visible in the background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-pitched 'ding' SFX marks the start as an energetic male speaker introduces the Lee Kum Kee brand. Fast-tempo acoustic guitar BGM provides a bright, rhythmic foundation. (2) Vocal pitch variability increases as the speaker highlights the 136-year history. BGM continues with a steady drum beat. (3) A distinct mechanical click SFX is heard as the bottle opens. The speaker's delivery becomes more animated while describing the new squeeze bottle's convenience. (4) Multiple subtle 'pop' SFX accompany visual text transitions. Vocal intensity remains high and authoritative through the product benefit explanation. (5) The speaker concludes with a positive, rising intonation, wishing the audience good cooking results. BGM maintains its upbeat tempo until a clean fade-out at the end.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Heritage Context -> Problem/Traditional comparison -> Solution (New Squeeze Bottle) -> Use Cases -> Closing
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional piece for Lee Kum Kee's new squeeze-bottle oyster sauce. It leverages the brand's 136-year heritage to establish trust, then transitions to a practical demonstration by a professional chef to show the convenience and lack of mess offered by the new packaging compared to traditional glass bottles.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Chef Jerry explicitly names and demonstrates the features of the Lee Kum Kee product, presenting it as a superior kitchen solution.

high_inference.freeDescribe: High-quality commercial content featuring a credible influencer-chef to bridge the gap between traditional brand values and modern consumer convenience.
